name: Ellipsoidal Kernel Splatting with Warped Slicing
aliases: Efficient ellipsoid slicing on the GPU
definition: A volume rendering method that represents point samples as 3D ellipsoids (generalized from spherical kernels) and rasterizes them by slicing the ellipsoid into 2D polygons. To avoid expensive square roots and conditional statements required by direct analytical ellipsoid slicing, the method warps the slicing planes from screen space into the coordinate system of a unit sphere. This allows the use of hard-wired GPU texture mapping and blending on radially symmetric kernel slices.
